sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Crl.P. No.7887 Of 2021
O R D E R:

1. When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor on instructions submits that the case has been transferred from Jaipur Police Station to Food Safety Officer,
Manchiriyal.

2. Recording the submission made by the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, the Criminal Petition is disposed off, granting liberty to the petitioners to question the proceedings filed before the Food Safety Officer, Manchiriyal.
3.
Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.

_ K.SURENDER, J Date: 02.05.2025 dv THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE K.SURENDER Crl.P.No.7887 OF 2021 Dt. 02.05.2025 dv Siripuram Santosh vs The State Of Telangana on 2 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162048179/
